title: gccom-mole-experiments: verification and validation of a mimetic internal-wave solver on fully curvilinear grids
description: Two-dimensional linear non-hydrostatic internal-wave solver on fully curvilinear grids using the MOLE mimetic operator library. Includes a seiche verification against the exact dispersion relation (second-order convergence to zero), a study of the lateral Robin regularisation parameter, and validation against the internal-wave-beam benchmark of Garcia et al. (2019), J. Comput. Sci. 30:143-156, sec. 3.3, with the fit-window and tracker dependence of the measured beam angle. Version 1.0.0 leaves open the origin of a residual first-order beam-angle offset of about -1 degree at omega/N = 0.8.
